from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5999879a.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform separator divides two equal-sized panels.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and r > 0 and h - r - 1 == r:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
                    for x, y in zip(top, bottom)]
    for c in range(w):
        col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1 and c > 0 and w - c - 1 == c:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
                    for x, y in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError("No centered uniform separator dividing equal panels")
'''
p.write_text(source)
grid=[[0,0,0,3,1,0,3,3,3],[0,3,3,0,1,0,3,3,0],[3,0,3,0,1,0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,0,1,0,3,3,3]]
ns={}; exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)
out=ns['transform'](grid)
print(p.exists(),out)
